title: AI recommendation-taking fails for high-conviction-gap decisions
essence: For weighty, high-conviction-gap decisions, outsourcing the call to an AI recommendation fails — you feel the answer before you can trust it; the receipt is missing.

title: Decisions arrive faster than you can position relative to them
essence: The firehose is a geometry problem, not overload: decisions arrive faster than you can position yourself relative to them — you lack a coordinate system.

title: Cartography density reduces time-to-bearing across sessions
essence: Accumulated receipt cartography density reduces time-to-bearing across sessions — the terrain you've navigated doesn't fog over again.

title: L6 cross-session pattern recognition requires dense receipt substrate
essence: L6 cross-session pattern recognition behavior requires a dense receipt substrate; architecturally specified, not yet implemented or validated.

title: L7 meta-governance constitutional enforcement
essence: L7 meta-governance constitutional enforcement behavior — specified as ROM candidate, promote when L7 is specified and implemented.

title: Most common failure mode is analysis at the wrong moment (cadence)
essence: The predominant high-stakes failure mode is not bad analysis but analysis conducted at the wrong moment in a decision's lifecycle — EMPIRICAL, needs frequency data.

title: Relief heuristic as Court diagnostic
essence: Ask what you'd feel if this were decided for you now: relief (not disappointment) is data that the topology is real and you've been deferring — a COURT trigger.

title: Co-founder cost receipt example
essence: The co-founder cost-receipt walkthrough is a composite from documented founding-team failure patterns, not a receipted session; promote when Observatory has a verified case.

ref: Axiom I — Decisions Are Bets Not Facts
title: Decisions are bets, not facts
essence: The system returns bearings not answers; a 57 NCI or YELLOW gate is an accurate reading of the manifold, not a failure to fix before acting.

ref: Axiom III — Time Quality Is First-Class
title: Time quality is a first-class NCI variable
essence: Time quality (tenure depth, process stage, window urgency) is a variable in NCI via the cadence lens; a well-formed question asked too early scores lower and may HOLD.

title: Repair visibly — Kintsugi immune system
essence: When building on a false premise, repair with gold not invisible adhesive: log compression ratios, inferred_fields, collision_fields; HOLD/REJECT are visible seams, not failures.

ref: Axiom VI — History Is a Teacher Not a Jailer
title: Past receipts shape probabilities without vetoing present moves
essence: Receipt trajectories inform but never veto present navigation; the delta between sessions (NCI, conviction, True North rotation) is itself information. parent_receipt_id encodes it.

ref: Axiom VII — Irreversibility Is Declared Not Assumed
title: Write-Lock / Kairos Lock — name one-way doors before crossing
essence: The system cannot detect one-way doors; irreversibility must be declared explicitly (Write-Lock in prep/receipt, Kairos Lock on constitutional artifacts) before you cross the topology.

title: W-field inference + cadence-lens ROM primitives
essence: Constitutional ROM: W-field (window) inference signals, time-quality degradation, and cadence NCI-lens scoring; governs dewy_vector.W, Y.stability, cadence, inferred_fields. Never override at runtime.

title: arcs-v9 auth model — anonymous vs authenticated compass (PRE-amendment variant)
essence: Option C: compass runs anonymously, account creation is a post-session prompt; Receipt.userId nullable. Scrub variant LACKS the 2026-06-12 launch-hardening amendment (history/share gating) present in live canon.

title: Tribune Intelligence Layer — three-phase annotation (PRE-collision naming variant)
essence: Tribune Layer = Anterior/Proactive/Posterior annotation wrapping sealed Receipt. Scrub variant preserves pre-collision labels 'BAR (Baseline/Asymmetric/Ruin)' and 'KKL (not KKR)'; live renamed to risk-tier/KLC after 2026-06-23 CANON_COLLISION.

ref: DEWY receipt schema v0.1.0 (prose companion, variant)
title: DEWY Receipt schema — human-readable companion
essence: A Receipt is a state vector frozen at L0–L5 completion: DEWY decomposition + Y-gate + NCI + render metadata; HOLD/REJECT emit stub receipts. Scrub differs from live variant.

title: DEWY Receipt JSON schema — canonical authority
essence: Machine-readable authority for the Receipt: dewy_vector, Y polarity/conviction/stability, nci by-lens, inferred_fields, collision_fields, parent_receipt_id lineage, validation_state.

title: Question to DEWY receipt pipeline flow
essence: Two-column SPEC-vs-IMPL flow for the L0–L5 pipeline with honest impl-delta notes (Kintsugi pathogen scan not wired; parse-collision HOLD passes through). Scrub differs from live variant.

title: Prisma 7 + Supabase pooler needs explicit Pool form
essence: new PrismaPg({connectionString}) config-object form never negotiates SSL against the Supabase pooler — DB writes silently fail in green builds. Use explicit Pool; verify with a real $queryRaw against prod.

ref: Auth.js silent sign-in fail → check Supabase pg logs
title: Auth.js swallows schema-gap errors; postgres logs are the tell
essence: When magic-link sign-in silently fails (form resets, no email), it's almost always a PrismaAdapter schema gap (e.g. missing emailVerified column); Auth.js swallows the DB error — check Supabase postgres logs immediately.

ref: Vercel build-log first line: Cloning vs Downloading
title: Diagnose stale deploys by the build log's first line
essence: 'Cloning github.com/...' = correct git-integration build; 'Downloading N deployment files' = a CLI upload that may be a stale local snapshot. Never vercel deploy --prod from a local tree; git push instead.

ref: Marketplace Supabase: create dedicated app role
title: Don't reset postgres role on Marketplace-provisioned Supabase
essence: For Vercel-Marketplace-provisioned Supabase, credentials are integration-managed — postgres-role password resets fail. Create a dedicated app role (arcs_app) with known credentials; upgrade Vercel CLI past env-pull bug.

title: Solid accent color only — no gradient buttons
essence: Gradient buttons read as AI-slop; use a solid primary accent color only. A recurring visual anti-pattern flagged twice in the compass atomic-design spec.

title: Architect↔Implementor state sync via git files + raw URL
essence: Maintain stateful context between Architect (cloud) and Implementor (local) surfaces with zero infra: _STATE/snapshot.json ground-truth committed to main + a GitHub raw URL — no DB, MCP, or auth.

title: Canon commit path: draft→hold→upstream audit→CONDITIONAL CLEAR→patch→CANONICAL
essence: The only valid commit path for _CANON/book-ii content: draft → hold → upstream ARCS audit → CONDITIONAL CLEAR with specific items → apply patches → mark CANONICAL → commit.
